messages.subject: lavPredict - following growth model
parts:
Hi Lavaan group users,

I am struggling with plotting predicted values from lavPredict. I have run a growth model with measuring cognition as a latent intercept and slope (composed of multiple neuropsychological tests at different follow-up periods), and would like to plot the change in cognition over time with respect to a latent predictor variable. 

Here is an example of the simplified code:

cognition <- '

latent_var =~ var1+ var2 + var3

intercept =~ a*test1_T1 + b*test2_T1 + c*test3_T1 +
a*test1_T2 + b*test1_T2 + c*test1_T2 ... (and so on)

slope =~ 0*test1_T1 + 0*test2_T1 + 0*test3_T1 +
A1*test1_T2 + B1*test2_T2 + C1*test3_T2 +.....

intercept + slope ~ latent_var + exp1 + exp2 + exp3 '

Does anyone have any insights into how this should be done? As mentioned already, I would like to plot the change in cognition over time with respects to the latent_var. 

Thank you
